revisions.prompt: Edit target: supplied umbrella repair illustration. Keep its cute flat marker style, thick slightly imperfect black outlines, visible marker texture, white border, turquoise character at left, green patch, yellow worktable at right, pink spool, blue background. Correct the umbrella GEOMETRY. Draw the umbrella in a perfectly frontal view with a bilaterally symmetric orange canopy: tip at 55% image width, left and right canopy edges equidistant from that axis and same height. Central lower rim is centered directly beneath tip. The single straight vertical shaft emerges from the exact CENTER of that rim and continues downward at the EXACT SAME x coordinate as the top tip. Replace J-shaped hook entirely with a STRAIGHT short cylindrical dark gray grip centered on the same shaft axis. Tip, canopy center, exposed shaft, and straight grip form one vertical line. NO hook, NO tilt, NO off-center shaft, NO oblique underside perspective. Use symmetric curved panel seams and small darker orange flat edge panels to show dome volume. Character's lower hand wraps around shaft while leaving shaft above and below visibly aligned; upper hand touches green patch. Simplify any conflicting seam structure. Do not draw construction guides, lettering, or labels. Preserve original subject and colors.
